# `state/codebook/PatternCodebook.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/codebook/PatternCodebook.js`

state/codebook/PatternCodebook.js — Phase 1 of the URC pipeline: raw 3x3 block -> 9-bit exact id -> canonical (rotations/flips) -> dense id + hash id + nearest legal attractor (Hamming distance).  This is the smallest stable codebook. Bigger blocks (8x8 DCT, 32x32 wavelets) plug into the resonance layer later; the contract here is: a raw pattern maps deterministically to a stable codebook entry.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor()` |  |
| `denseId` | `denseId(rawId)` | Allocate (or fetch) a dense runtime id for a raw pattern's canonical form. |
| `canonicalForDense` | `canonicalForDense(dense)` |  |
| `size` | `get size()` |  |
| `registerLegal` | `registerLegal(rawId)` | Mark a canonical pattern as legal (an attractor that corrupted input may snap to). |
| `nearestLegal` | `nearestLegal(rawId)` | Snap a (possibly corrupted) raw pattern to the nearest LEGAL canonical attractor by Hamming distance. Resonance *suggests*; this never asserts truth — callers decide whether to accept (visual) or verify (semantic). |

## Functions

### `packPattern(cells)`

Pack a length-9 array of truthy/0 cells (row-major) into a 9-bit id (0..511).

### `unpackPattern(id)`

Unpack a 9-bit id back into a length-9 Uint8Array (row-major).

### `hammingDistance(a, b)`

Number of differing cells between two packed 3x3 patterns.

### `symmetries(id)`

All 8 dihedral symmetries of a packed pattern.

### `canonicalId(id)`

Canonical id = smallest packed id over all dihedral symmetries (rotation/flip invariant).

### `patternHashId(rawId)`

Stable content fingerprint for a pattern (hash = identity).
